d: Enjoy the super hit Romantic title song of the movie Hum Aapke Hain Koun! sung by Lata Mangeshkar, S. P. Balasubrahmanyam from Rajshri Production's Blockbuster movie Hum Aapke Hain Kaun (1994) starring Salman Khan & Madhuri Dixit in the lead. Music composed by Raam Laxman. The other star cast includes, Mohnish Bahl, Renuka Shahane, Anupam Kher, Reema Lagoo, Alok Nath, Lakshmikant Berde. The movie is Directed by Sooraj.R. Barjatya.
